name: mern-crud-application
description: Ready to use MERN Stack CRUD Application (Node, Express, MongoDB, React)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: powershell -Command "Start-Process npm -ArgumentList 'run dev --prefix backend' -NoNewWindow; npm run dev --prefix frontend"
